answer: A fresh key is a hollow shell: it can claim anything but carries no sealed, quorum-matched grading history behind it. In PoA an agent's weight comes only from on-ledger verdicts it sealed one epoch at a time, each re-checked against consensus — a record as hard to counterfeit as bending a comet's path. Spin up a thousand clones and each must still cross the whole ocean of honest judgment alone; the Sybil bill scales linearly with identities, and no warmed credential transfers.
